description: SWE-bench Verified is increasingly contaminated and mismeasures frontier coding progress. Our analysis shows flawed tests and training leakage. We recommend SWE-bench Pro.

title: OpenAI announces Frontier Alliance Partners
description: OpenAI announces Frontier Alliance Partners to help enterprises move from AI pilots to production with secure, scalable agent deployments.

title: Our First Proof submissions
description: We share our AI model’s proof attempts for the First Proof math challenge, testing research-grade reasoning on expert-level problems.

title: Advancing independent research on AI alignment
description: OpenAI commits $7.5M to The Alignment Project to fund independent AI alignment research, strengthening global efforts to address AGI safety and security risks.

title: Introducing OpenAI for India
description: OpenAI for India expands AI access across the country—building local infrastructure, powering enterprises, and advancing workforce skills.

title: Introducing EVMbench
description: OpenAI and Paradigm introduce EVMbench, a benchmark evaluating AI agents’ ability to detect, patch, and exploit high-severity smart contract vulnerabilities.

title: GPT-5.2 derives a new result in theoretical physics
description: A new preprint shows GPT-5.2 proposing a new formula for a gluon amplitude, later formally proved and verified by OpenAI and academic collaborators.

title: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT
description: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT to help organizations defend against prompt injection and AI-driven data exfiltration.

title: Beyond rate limits: scaling access to Codex and Sora
description: How OpenAI built a real-time access system combining rate limits, usage tracking, and credits to power continuous access to Sora and Codex.

title: Scaling social science research
description: GABRIEL is a new open-source toolkit from OpenAI that uses GPT to turn qualitative text and images into quantitative data, helping social scientists analyze research at scale.
